note: First validation with verified full noise coverage. ghz_scattered_0_63_126 was killed (MPS memory, two 26-hop routes) and is omitted.
root_cause: v3 models two-qubit gate error only, with no decoherence term. Routes through low-T2 qubits are catastrophically under-penalized; long routes through healthy qubits are over-penalized by SWAP compounding.

worst_qubit.note: edges (79,80) and (80,81) have NO calibration data, so v3 used its 1% fallback exactly where reality is worst

naive_decoherence_fix.verdict: rejected - charging duration/T2 per gate to both qubits double-counts along a SWAP chain, fixing short bad routes while destroying long good ones
